correctness.rationale: Exact summation gives T'=b-delta T and X'=[q(T-X)-(nu+delta)]X. At qK=nu+delta this reduces to Y'=-delta Y and X'=q(Y-X)X, whose reciprocal equation is linear and yields tX->1/q. For R_D<1, eventual cooperative domination by Hurwitz Metzler matrices gives exponential decay of infected and recovered classes, proving the full asymptotic profile and global convergence; R_D>1 gives a positive disease eigenvalue.

value.rationale: The papers identify the behavioral ratio as a control threshold but leave equality nonhyperbolic and outside the strict stability theorem. Closing that boundary with a sharp universal 1/t coefficient and showing exponential-versus-algebraic rate separation changes the predicted clearance timescale exactly where behavioral control is marginal, making the result structurally and interpretively useful rather than a routine parameter substitution.
